dimensions.evidence: Inputs n1,n2 dimensionless, C in 1/m (L^-1), d_o in m (L); numerator L, denominator (1)(L^-1)(L)-1=1, output d_i in m (L). The coherent 1/m unit is claimed as a research extension, not silently assumed.

guards-inverses.evidence: Guards n1,n2>=1, d_o>0, and squared-denominator>0 reject the first-focus case (denominator exactly (0.5)(10)(0.2)-1=0), the on-interface object case (d_o=0; C=0 itself valid), and the missing-C case, all present. d_i=0 is impossible under the guards (requires n2*d_o=0). Finite R recovery correctly requires C!=0, and C=0 (plane, R infinite) is distinguished from the original forbidden R=0. Each non-singular inverse direction has one root; refractive-index inversions honestly not assessed.

reference-independence.evidence: All four references recomputed two ways. Expression route: r1 1.5*0.4/(0.5*10*0.4-1)=0.6; r2 0.6/(0.5*(-10)*0.4-1)=-0.2; r3 1.33*0.4/(0-1.33)=-0.4; r4 1*0.3/((1-1.5)*0*0.3-1.5)=-0.2, all within floating-point noise (~2e-16) of expected, far inside tol 1e-12. Independent ray routes re-derived: r1 outgoing slope -0.01+0.0125/1.5 reaches the axis at 0.6 m; r2 slope +0.005 back-projects to -0.2 m; r4 plane slopes 1/300 in and 1.5/300=0.005 out back-project to 0.2 m depth, signed -0.2 m; r3 is the equal-index identity. Inverse checks recomputed: d_o=0.6/(0.5*10*0.6-1.5)=0.4, C=(0.6+0.6)/(0.5*0.4*0.6)=10; plane d_o=0.3, C=0/0.03=0; n1=n2 with d_i=-d_o gives 0/0, confirming the stated underdetermination.

scope.evidence: Single refracting interface, paraxial rays, real object (d_o>0), ordinary transparent real-index media (n>=1) at one optical frequency, semi-infinite medium 2. Second surfaces, thick-lens/sphere systems, oblique plane viewing, image intensity, transmission fraction, group delay, diffraction, and polarization excluded. Equal-index no-refraction and C=0 plane limits explicitly admitted as labeled limits. Scope revision under the same ID, not a renamed clone.

source-fidelity.evidence: Live-inspected UP3 Sec 2.3: Eq 2.11 n1/do+n2/di=(n2-n1)/R with the small-angle derivation (n1(h/do+h/R)=n2(h/R-h/di)); Eq 2.10 hi=(n2/n1)ho derived as the normal-view small-angle approximation with angle-dependent depth explicitly noted; sign convention R>0 convex toward object and di>0 real on the opposite side. Introduced curvature C=1/R preserves the convention (C>0 center on outgoing side); solving Eq 2.11 for d_i yields exactly the serialized expression (verified algebraically). Plane mapping d_i=-h_i, d_o=h_o reproduces Eq 2.10 from the C=0 limit (verified). Axial apparent depth vs transverse image height confusion explicitly guarded.

models.permitted_use: Theoretical use of d_i=n2*d_o/((n2-n1)*C*d_o-n1) for paraxial imaging at one spherical or plane refracting interface (real object, SI m and 1/m, real-is-positive convention); educational and lens-geometry computations only. Excludes multi-surface systems, oblique plane viewing beyond the normal-view approximation, R=0 surfaces, and any intensity/polarization/diffraction prediction.
